title: India win U19 Asia Cup off the last ball; US flights halted by telecom failure; exports hit record in October

morning.greeting: Good morning, and happy Janjatiya Gaurav Divas!
morning.line: It's Sunday. A good day to rest, read something you enjoy and get ready for the week.
morning.thought: A match is never over until the last ball. Keep trying until the very end.

day.name: Janjatiya Gaurav Divas
day.about: 15 November is the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda (born 1875), the tribal leader who fought British rule. It is observed as Janjatiya Gaurav Divas to honour India's tribal communities. The state of Jharkhand was also formed on this day in 2000.

word.meaning: able to recover quickly and keep going after a difficulty.
word.example: The resilient team kept fighting even when they needed many runs in the last overs.

morning.task: Find out the name of one tribal freedom fighter from your own state and share one fact about them tomorrow.

headlines.title: India beat Pakistan by one wicket off the last ball to win the Under-19 Asia Cup for the ninth time.
headlines.summary: Chasing 338 in the final on 14 November, India finished on 339/9 when Mohit Ulva (49 not out off 26 balls) hit a four off the final ball. Captain Lakshya Raichandani scored 80 and Aaryavir Sehwag 58. Earlier, Pakistan made 337/9, with Usman Khan scoring 107 and Kavya Patel taking 4 wickets for India. Ulva was Man of the Final and Sehwag, with 361 runs, Man of the Tournament.
headlines.gk: India have now won the U19 Asia Cup nine times, the most by any team. The tournament is organised by the Asian Cricket Council (ACC). Pakistan had won the previous final in 2025 in Dubai.

headlines.title: The India International Trade Fair opens in New Delhi with the theme 'Vikas aur Virasat'.
headlines.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal opened the 14-day fair, which has more than 3,500 exhibitors and 32 States and Union Territories taking part. He said India's exports touched a record of nearly $90 billion in October, about $50 billion of goods and $40 billion of services, and that India is on course for its $1 trillion export target.
headlines.gk: The IITF is organised every November by the India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO). 'Vikas aur Virasat' means 'development and heritage'.

headlines.title: Devotees observe Kharna, the second day of Chhath Puja, beginning a 36-hour fast.
headlines.summary: On Kharna, devotees fast all day without food or water and break the fast in the evening after praying to the Sun God and Chhathi Maiya, with prasad of jaggery kheer and wheat rotis. This starts the 36-hour 'nirjala' fast. The evening offering to the setting Sun (Sandhya Arghya) comes next, and the festival ends on Monday morning with Usha Arghya to the rising Sun.
headlines.gk: Chhath is a four-day festival dedicated to the Sun God (Surya). It begins with 'Nahay-Khay' and is celebrated mainly in Bihar, Jharkhand and eastern Uttar Pradesh.

headlines.title: A telecom failure in air traffic control stops departing flights across the USA for over four hours.
headlines.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) halted departing flights nationwide after a telecommunications failure hit all 22 air traffic control centres; it started in Chicago. Nearly 7,000 flights were delayed or cancelled. Officials said there was no sign of an attack. Air India warned passengers of knock-on delays on its US flights.
headlines.gk: The FAA is the US government body that runs civil aviation and air traffic control. India's equivalent regulator is the DGCA, and air traffic control is run by the Airports Authority of India (AAI).

headlines.title: ISRO ground-tests the upgraded third stage of the PSLV rocket.
headlines.summary: ISRO carried out a static fire test of the upgraded PS3 stage at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota. The stage was improved after problems in the PSLV-C61/EOS-09 and PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 missions. Changes include a revised nozzle, stronger joints, extra sealing and more non-destructive checks.
headlines.gk: PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) has four stages; the third stage (PS3) uses solid fuel. In a 'static test' the engine is fired while held firmly on the ground.

headlines.title: India win 10 medals at the 2026 Youth Olympics, including their first-ever boxing golds.
headlines.summary: India won 2 gold, 3 silver and 5 bronze medals, their second-best tally after 13 medals in 2018. Boxers Gunjan (women's 48 kg) and Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei (men's 50 kg) won gold. India won medals in 7 of the 11 sports it entered, including first medals in swimming, beach wrestling and wushu. Five medallists are Khelo India athletes.
headlines.gk: The Youth Olympic Games are for athletes aged 15-18. The first Summer Youth Olympics were held in Singapore in 2010. Dakar is the capital of Senegal, the first African host.

headlines.title: India's merchandise exports hit a record $49.47 billion in October, up 45% year on year.
headlines.summary: Total exports of goods and services rose nearly 30% to $89.99 billion. Imports rose about 16.6% to over $110 billion, so the trade deficit narrowed to $20.09 billion. Petroleum products, electronics, gems and jewellery, chemicals and engineering goods led the growth. April-October exports are estimated at over $568 billion, up more than 16%.
headlines.gk: Trade deficit = imports minus exports. Monthly trade data is released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Minister: Piyush Goyal).
headlines.exam: Remember the record figure ($49.47 bn merchandise, $89.99 bn total) and the trade deficit ($20.09 bn). Questions often ask which sector led export growth.

headlines.title: India's forex reserves rise by $2.49 billion to $719.547 billion.
headlines.summary: In the week ended 6 November 2026, foreign currency assets rose to $591.350 billion and gold reserves rose by $2.205 billion to $104.796 billion. Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) stood at $18.610 billion and the reserve position with the IMF at $4.791 billion. In the previous week, reserves had fallen by $2.691 billion.
headlines.gk: Forex reserves have four parts: foreign currency assets, gold, SDRs and the reserve tranche position in the IMF. The RBI publishes the data every Friday in its Weekly Statistical Supplement.
headlines.exam: Learn the four components and the largest one (foreign currency assets). The headline figure, $719.5 bn, is a likely one-liner question.

headlines.title: RBI issues the Domestic Money Transfer Directions, 2026.
headlines.summary: The directions bring the rules on domestic money transfers together. A walk-in customer without a bank account can deposit up to Rs 50,000 in cash to send via NEFT to a beneficiary's account. Cash pay-out is capped at Rs 10,000 per transaction, with a monthly limit of Rs 25,000 per beneficiary.
headlines.gk: NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) is run by the RBI and works 24x7. The RBI was set up on 1 April 1935.
headlines.exam: Note the three limits: Rs 50,000 (cash-to-account via NEFT), Rs 10,000 (cash pay-out per transaction) and Rs 25,000 (monthly per beneficiary).

headlines.title: NPCI launches the UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme for small merchants.
headlines.summary: The scheme targets merchants with annual turnover up to Rs 40 lakh, mainly in Tier-III to Tier-VI cities, the North-East, J&K and Ladakh. It will run for 3 years from the date UPI MDR is implemented (not yet notified) and is funded by 5% of the MDR collected. It aims to add 6 lakh to 1 crore new QR codes and 5-10 lakh soundboxes a year.
headlines.gk: NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India), set up in 2008, runs UPI, RuPay and FASTag. MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) is the fee a merchant pays on digital payments.
headlines.exam: Remember the turnover limit (Rs 40 lakh), the 3-year duration and the funding source (5% of MDR). Also know the full forms NPCI and MDR.

headlines.title: NITI Aayog report on PLI schemes: Rs 2.4 lakh crore investment, 76% of target.
headlines.summary: The 'Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes' covers all 14 sectors and was prepared with IIM Ahmedabad. By March 2026, with 58% of the implementation period over, the schemes had brought Rs 2.4 lakh crore of investment and Rs 22.66 lakh crore of production and sales (64% of target). Large-scale electronics, pharma, telecom and food products were on track.
headlines.gk: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes give companies incentives on extra sales of goods made in India. NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on 1 January 2015; the PM is its chairperson.
headlines.exam: Remember: 14 sectors, knowledge partner IIM Ahmedabad, Rs 2.4 lakh crore investment (76% of target).

headlines.title: RBI approves Pratap Singh as MD & CEO of Fino Payments Bank for three years.
headlines.summary: The appointment takes effect from 27 November 2026 or the date he takes charge, whichever is earlier. He succeeds interim CEO Ketan Merchant, who took over after Rishi Gupta's early retirement in May 2026. Singh has over 29 years of banking experience, including heading retail and SME banking for the UK and Europe at ICICI Bank UK.
headlines.gk: Payments banks can accept deposits (up to Rs 2 lakh per customer) but cannot give loans or issue credit cards. They were set up on the recommendation of the Nachiket Mor Committee.
headlines.exam: Appointment questions: match person to organisation (Pratap Singh - Fino Payments Bank). Also revise payments bank rules: Rs 2 lakh deposit limit, no lending.

quiz.q: By what margin did India beat Pakistan in the U19 Asia Cup final?
quiz.explain: India chased 338 and won by one wicket off the last ball.

quiz.q: What is the theme of the India International Trade Fair 2026?
quiz.explain: The theme is 'Vikas aur Virasat' (development and heritage).

quiz.q: Chhath Puja is dedicated mainly to which deity?
quiz.explain: Chhath honours the Sun God (Surya) and Chhathi Maiya.

quiz.q: Which US body halted departing flights after the telecom failure?
quiz.explain: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) runs US air traffic control.

quiz.q: ISRO tested an upgraded stage of which rocket?
quiz.explain: It was the upgraded third stage (PS3) of the PSLV.

quiz.q: Where were the 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games held?
quiz.explain: They were held in Dakar, Senegal.

quiz.q: What were India's total exports (goods and services) in October 2026?
quiz.explain: Total exports were $89.99 billion; $49.47 bn was goods alone.

quiz.q: Which is the largest component of India's forex reserves?
quiz.explain: Foreign currency assets were $591.35 billion of the $719.5 billion.

quiz.q: Under the RBI's new directions, what is the cash pay-out limit per transaction?
quiz.explain: Cash pay-out is capped at Rs 10,000 per transaction.

quiz.q: The UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme is for merchants with annual turnover up to:
quiz.explain: It targets small merchants with turnover up to Rs 40 lakh.

quiz.q: Which institution was NITI Aayog's knowledge partner for the PLI impact report?
quiz.explain: IIM Ahmedabad was the knowledge partner.

quiz.q: Pratap Singh has been appointed MD & CEO of which bank?
quiz.explain: The RBI approved him as MD & CEO of Fino Payments Bank.

ai.title: AI and computational thinking now taught in CBSE schools from Class 3.
ai.summary: From the 2026-27 session, CBSE has brought in a curriculum on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for Classes 3 to 8, and plans to extend it to Classes 9 and 10 next session. Educators say the aim is not just to use AI tools but to build judgement and critical thinking. The topic was discussed around National Education Day (11 November).
ai.gk: National Education Day (11 November) marks the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, India's first Education Minister. CBSE stands for Central Board of Secondary Education.

quiz.q: From which class does CBSE's new AI and computational thinking curriculum begin?
quiz.explain: It covers Classes 3 to 8 from the 2026-27 session.

ai.title: UNESCO launches 'AI Answers. You Decide', a guide to help students think critically about AI.
ai.summary: The guide helps teachers build media and information literacy in the age of AI. It has five units, starting with 'AI in Our Pocket' and ending with 'AI Futures Are Being Built Now'. It was written by eight international experts and launched during Global Media and Information Literacy Week 2026. It is in English now, with French, Spanish and Arabic to follow.
ai.gk: UNESCO is the UN agency for education, science and culture, headquartered in Paris. It was founded in 1945.

quiz.q: UNESCO's new AI guide is mainly about building which skill?
quiz.explain: It puts critical thinking and media and information literacy at the centre.

ai.title: Research review: AI tools help teachers more than students.
ai.summary: Stanford's AI Hub for Education (SCALE Initiative) reviewed 52 studies, including 32 new rigorous ones. Teachers saved time making lesson plans with AI without losing quality, but students who believed a lesson was AI-made felt less motivated. In one study from Turkey, students did worse when weaker teachers relied on AI lesson plans. The authors say AI used without thought can harm learning.
ai.gk: A randomised controlled trial (RCT) randomly splits people into groups to test whether something really causes an effect.
ai.exam: For teachers: use AI to save planning time, but keep your own judgement in the lesson. Good evidence point for essays on AI in education.

quiz.q: According to the review, who benefited more from AI tools?
quiz.explain: Teachers saved time on lesson planning; student benefits were limited.

ai.title: Rajnath Singh unveils indigenous AI applications built by the IAF's UDAAN unit.
ai.summary: The Defence Minister launched the AI tools on 12 November at the Air Force Commanders' Conference 2026 in New Delhi. They automate work in operations, administration and aerospace safety. UDAAN is the IAF's Unit for Digitisation, Automation, AI and Application Networking.
ai.gk: UDAAN's AI Centre of Excellence was inaugurated on 10 July 2022 at Air Force Station Rajokri, New Delhi. The IAF was founded on 8 October 1932.
ai.exam: Remember the full form of UDAAN and the event (Air Force Commanders' Conference 2026). Defence + AI is a frequent current-affairs combination.

quiz.q: Who unveiled the IAF's indigenous AI applications from UDAAN?
quiz.explain: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched them at AFCC 2026.
